scope: Author experiment, not a learner seal or independent review
disclosure: The controller and finite functional oracle were already explored. These are cost predictions recorded before the new host timing campaign, not blind functional predictions.
prediction: An independent short hedge can reduce client reply ticks for a long original tail while quiescence still waits for the original owner.
Under correlated complete loss, a hedge spends some of the same finite token budget without creating a successful reply; its work cannot be credited as free latency reduction.
Pre-ACK restart adds a delivery and recovery reads without creating another effect or durable acknowledgment.
Slow consumer start can delay notification credit release beyond response completion without adding request work.
No host time winner or hard latency bound is assumed; allocator, mutex, fixture and measurement overhead are included and separately described.
required_evidence: clean and single-unit incremental build time
layout, stack, link map, generated calls and unresolved symbols
limits: Virtual transport ticks are not measured network latency
